purpose: Qualify parent-equity and related balance-sheet amount facts from already-qualified saved annual consolidated statements; no factor score or market effect.
rules: Keep each original/version separately; do not pick latest by numerical value
Use qualified consolidated assets-table current-column and currency/unit binding only
Only fully aligned two numeric amount cells; one blank or three ambiguous cells is unknown
Never fill blank with zero; accounting capital in yuan is not legal ordinary shares
All records remain source candidates; no ordinary-equity numerator, share count, market cap or score generated
Do not use later original to fill missing old version
Announcement date is source date; precise release time and vendor availability remain unknown
Boundary must be confirmed before next financial table; exceeding page limit fails closed
audit_selection: Before execution: minimum sha256(code|year|announcement_id) among qualified table originals in each year; inspect original current and comparator parent-equity rows independently. Unknown/absent stays unknown; 12 cases are error detection, not statistical certification.
